Safety and Risk Management

LNG facility safety begins with recognition that catastrophic consequences accompany any failures in cryogenic infrastructure. Massive energy release from pressurized cryogenic fluid failure could affect wide geographic areas. Regulatory oversight reflects recognition of extreme hazard potential, establishing some of the most stringent safety standards in industrial practice.

Risk-based inspection programs at LNG facilities prioritize equipment with highest consequence potential. Tank integrity inspection receives intensive focus recognizing catastrophic consequences of tank failure. Process equipment inspection frequency reflects operational criticality and failure consequence severity. NDT consulting services help operators develop inspection strategies optimizing safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Safety system testing including emergency relief valve verification, isolation system function checks, and control system performance validation must occur on defined schedules. NDTConnect platform manages complex documentation and scheduling requirements across distributed LNG facility networks.

Comprehensive NDT programs at LNG facilities represent the foundation of safe, reliable operations of these specialized infrastructure systems. Commitment to inspection excellence maintains public safety and stakeholder confidence in responsible management of critical energy infrastructure.
